profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a seasoned and versatile software engineer with a particular passion for removing engineers' bottlenecks to productivity. I bring a wealth of experience in dev productivity tools, full-stack development, quality engineering, test automation, and CI/CD to any team.

My technical expertise spans a variety of technologies, including Typescript/Node, PostgreSQL, React + Redux, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS services. While Node-land is most familiar, I've dabbled in Go and am always excited by picking up new technologies.

I also have a background in entrepreneurship, small business, leadership, and management. This unique combination enables me to approach problems from multiple angles and find creative solutions that others might overlook.

In my downtime, you might find me embarking on an epic EV road trip, exploring nature, skiing, reading books that change my perspectives on the world, caring for my furry friends, or indulging in video/board games.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led multiple quality engineering initiatives, including failure injection testing, contract testing, and end-to-end API integration test automation, all as part of CI/CD.
- Designed, developed, deployed, and maintained a multi-purpose orchestrator service that greatly reduced testing timeline for launch of a major product (insurance decision automation); runs automated regression tests for underwriting backend systems; and automated policy creation to aid in manual testing of policy documents. (See tech blog.)
- Developed automation for testing PDF document data accuracy, improving testing efficiency and accuracy.
- Successfully collaborated with cross-functional teams to implement testing initiatives and increase speed of product rollouts.
- Supported in onboarding new teammates onto tools I built, enabling them to extend usage of those tools to their respective pods.
positions.insights: Skills: Redis · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · Docker · Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Chaos Engineering · Jest · React.js · GitHub Actions · TypeScript · Test Automation · Benthos · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Designed schemas and relationships amidst migration from Redis to PostgreSQL and optimized queries for efficiency and security.
- Implemented features and optimizations on the UI to ensure smoother and more intuitive workflow for clients and operations/medical staff, while advancing internal APIs to ensure data integrity and HIPAA compliance post-migration.
- Hunted down bugs across the tech stack, which included React, styled components, a custom-built router and Redux-like store, Deno with Oak, Redis for sessions, Docker, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS, and a microservice architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Increased test coverage with Enzyme for React/Redux to ensure proper rendering; and Jest with Express to validate controller outputs during authentication to facilitate continuous integration.
- Directly mentored teams of junior engineers that developed open-source projects and conducted code reviews, white-boarding, and trouble-shooting sessions while mentoring them on technologies across the full-stack.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and published the NPM module ​chronos-tracker​, with the ​systeminformation​ module as a complement, to retrieve and log container health stats on Dockerized microservices to PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases.
- Made critical inter-services communication data observable by leveraging ​hpropagate​ NPM module to do distributed tracing and to enable visualization of the speed, time, and volume.
- Built and containerized Express.js test microservices with Nginx reverse proxy to test the custom NPM module.
- Enhanced data visualization on the Electron GUI (built with React Context API), a cross-platform app that rendered microservices health and communication data into graphs and charts.
- ** Product developed under accelerator OS Labs (opensourcelabs.io).

positions.title: ScholarShipper
positions.description: - Combined Electron.js and React/React Router/Hooks to create a SPA with an Express.js + PostgreSQL backend for use by a non-profit organization to keep track of scholarship application status and cohort/student information.

positions.title: Parks Planner
positions.description:
- Used React, Redux (with Thunk) to build an intuitive UI while incorporating Google Maps API to render interactive pins on the map.
- Built an Express.js backend that integrated NPS.gov APIs to render park data on a map for easy navigation by users.

positions.title: Regional Manager/SVP
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description:
In addition to the core leadership, management, and entrepreneurial endeavors that helped the company scaled from a small shop to three highly popular locations in SoCal, I:
- wrote JavaScript in a Google Forms Add-On and created a microsite for customers to seamlessly place advance orders and submit payments and bypass other costly options.
- designed Excel VBA algorithms to calculate front-of-house tip pooling while incorporating an internal ranking system, ensuring efficiency and reducing errors.
positions.insights: Skills: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) · JavaScript · Team Leadership · Customer Experience · Operations Management

educations.schoolName: UC San Diego Jacobs School of Engineering
